يصطبنوا (form VIII)
# يَصْطَبِنُوا (yaṣṭabinū) /jasˤ.tˤa.bi.nuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَبَنَ (iṣṭabana)
# يُصْطَبَنُوا (yuṣṭabanū) /jusˤ.tˤa.ba.nuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَبَنَ (iṣṭabana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
